location: Western Forests — Old-growth elven forests west of the fort.
rewardEnvelope: the fee is as agreed, and any spoils ride home with it
stakeIfLost: Mercuro says his woodland tollhouse deed will be seized by creditors if Thallik is not returned, costing him the toll income that keeps him solvent.
arrival: sent word twice before coming · named a price before being asked
OPPOSES: warden · keep the exile under elven protection and prevent his delivery to human courts.
clientTell: watches your hands, not your face

cast.name: Mercuro Coalgate
cast.who: Minor lord who holds the tollhouse at Rookford and fears losing his income.
cast.want: to receive the exile named by the client in Rookford for judgment.

cast.name: Thallik Bonechewer
cast.who: Exiled wolfman sailor who returned from sea with coin and odd goods and took forest refuge.
cast.want: to remain at liberty to sell trout at market and stay out of Mercuro's custody.

bible.goal: to capture Thallik Bonechewer and deliver him to Mercuro Coalgate at Rookford for judgment.

relevantLore.name: Rookford
relevantLore.blurb: A market village with a tollhouse and a weekly fish market the lord relies on.

arcStep: Go to Ashen Ford, the first place Mercuro named, and question the ferry tavern for signs of the exile
